_comment: How /sentrook why and background-save notices show a call. Both plugins must give `lines` for `call` (the pending_call as sent to the scanner), with `total` (default the why limit) and `header` (default the why header). Every rendered character counts against the budget, so the text stays near `total` whatever the call's shape.
